title: [AUG-176] Research: Ghost Mode free X/Y drag with saved position and Stop Meeting protection
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 4): the ghost overlay (teleprompter/compact overlay) moves only up and down. He wants free drag on X and Y anywhere on the screen with the position saved in config, and protection from accidentally pressing Stop Meeting, which is too exposed in ghost mode. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [x] Current ghost window behavior described with file:line refs (CompactController, ghost-drag / ghost-caption-resize IPC, docked-edge logic, compactCaptionHeight).
- [x] Free-drag design proposed: what happens to edge docking and resize, multi-monitor and DPI handling, off-screen recovery, which pref stores the position.
- [x] Stop Meeting protection options compared with a recommendation, consistent with the live-mode Stop Live research (AUG-175). (Resolved before this card ran: AUG-182 shipped hold-to-stop in both ghost widgets; the mockup reproduces it unchanged.)
- [x] Windows and macOS behavior of the transparent always-on-top window checked (desk check from source + Electron 44; hardware run pending in AUG-187).
- [x] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-176/ghost-mode.html (opens in a browser, no build) with a fake desktop where Ghost Caption / Ghost Coin can be dragged freely on X and Y (snap behavior per option shown) and the protected Stop Meeting interaction works; built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [x] The user picks an option on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [x] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board; its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. electron/src/main.ts and compact.ts are shared high-risk files. Roadmap: M2 Live session control. Order: 7/10.

Input from AUG-175 (decided 2026-11-03): Stop Live uses **hold to stop for 1.5 s** (progress fill, cancel on early release), implemented as a shared component in AUG-182. Ghost Stop Meeting should reuse that pattern so the app has one Stop pattern; mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-175/live-controls.html.

Update 2026-11-03 (AUG-182 revision 2): Stop Meeting protection is ALREADY DONE in AUG-182 — Ghost Caption [ ■ ] End Meeting and Ghost Coin [ END MEETING ] are 1.5 s hold-to-stop (HoldToStopButton), the END? confirm is removed, and skipStopConfirmation is gone from the client. Ghost Caption also got Stop Live Text (hold). Remaining scope of this research: free X/Y drag with a saved position only.

## Research (2026-11-03)
**Today (as built):**
- Caption drag @client/src/components/compact/GhostApp.tsx:62-76 (left zone) → ghost-drag IPC (@electron/src/preload.cts:71-73, @electron/src/main.ts:544-547) → @electron/src/compact.ts:217-251. Move: **X pinned to the start x**, Y clamped to the start display's work area (:229-232) — this is Rodion's "only up/down". End: snaps to Top/Bottom by window center (:241-243), full geometry recomputed by ghostBounds (:328-335): width min(760, 80 % wa), centered, 24 px margin.
- Coin drag GhostApp.tsx:255-283 (4 px click/drag threshold) → compact.ts:234: free X/Y, no clamp; end snaps to the nearest corner (:245-248), 16 px margin (:336-340); hover expansion ghostResize (:209-215) regrows from the corner; GhostApp.tsx:251-253 flips row direction by screen half.
- Caption height: GhostApp.tsx:78-92 handle, compact.ts:253-275 keeps the docked edge fixed via captionEdge from the last snap; clamp 72–480; end → caption-height event → @client/src/components/compact/CompactLayer.tsx:225 → PATCH compactCaptionHeight (client preferences.ts:47,81; server routes/preferences.ts:43; preferencesStore.ts:133-137). Handle side derived in GhostApp.tsx:52-55 from window.screenY vs availTop/availHeight.
- Position memory: captionEdge / captionHeight / coinCorner are CompactController fields (compact.ts:106-108) — kept while the app runs, reset every launch; nothing on disk. Precedent for geometry: <userData>/window-state.json (@electron/src/windowState.ts:27-43, fitWindowState :48-63 with the ≥100 px visible rule).
- Ghost window compact.ts:349-400: frameless, transparent, resizable false, movable true (no effect without -webkit-app-region), skipTaskbar, applyOnTop (:62-70: macOS 'floating' + all workspaces incl. full-screen; Windows flag only), showInactive, caption click-through setIgnoreMouseEvents(forward) (:397); ghost IPC only from the ghost webContents (main.ts:532-552).
- Tools clipped at small heights (Rodion's screenshot, 2026-11-03): the five caption tools are a 3-column grid (`.ghost-caption-tools--grid`, App.css) in the 104 px left zone; at low heights the second row ([ TXT ] [ ■ ]) is cut off, so End Meeting is unreachable.

**Free-drag design:** apply dx and dy (drop the pin at compact.ts:231), no clamp while moving (can cross displays), clamp on release to the display the window overlaps most. Release options: A magnetic edges (snap flush within 32 DIP with today's margins, else stay) · B free (clamp only) · C 3×3 anchor grid. Caption resize keeps the handle on the edge facing the display center, fixed edge derived at resize start from the window center (not the last snap). Optional width resize 320–760 (compactCaptionWidth mirrored like compactCaptionHeight). Coin expands toward the display center, flips when 372 px does not fit. Restore on ensureGhost by displayId → fallback main-window display → anchors+offsets+size → clamp → invalid → today's default; re-clamp on screen display-removed / display-metrics-changed; Settings → Compact mode "Reset overlay position".
**Storage recommendation:** <userData>/window-state.json, key `ghost: { caption?, coin? }`, record `{ displayId, hAnchor:'left'|'right', hOffset, vAnchor:'top'|'bottom', vOffset }` in DIP, written by main on drag/resize end (no renderer round-trip, no server schema). Alternative rejected: a compactGhostPosition pref via PATCH (object sanitizer + new compact-event just to hand the value back; display ids/DIP are machine geometry like the main window bounds).
**Multi-monitor / DPI:** Electron bounds and getCursorScreenPoint are DIP in one virtual screen on both OSes; Windows mixed-DPI can re-scale a transparent window mid-drag (WM_DPICHANGED) → re-apply width/height on release with setBounds, not only position.
**Windows / macOS desk check** (source + Electron 44 docs; not run on hardware): Windows setPosition is never constrained (clamp to workArea to avoid taskbar z-fights); macOS AppKit constrains frames against the visible frame — clamping to workArea (no menu bar/Dock) avoids adjustments, verify on macOS 15; click-through forward supported on both; macOS all-workspaces keeps the ghost on every display's Spaces. Status: desk check only.
Mockup: @docs/mockups/AUG-176/ghost-mode.html — verified in Chrome: free drag with magnetic snap, saved `ghost` record readout, RELAUNCH restore, two displays (mixed DPI), coin hover expansion toward the screen center, hold-to-stop END MEETING (a click does nothing); caption tools stay rectangular while two rows fit (down to ~92 px), switch to one row of squares below, resize floor at 72 — both thresholds measured from the layout.

## Decision (user, 2026-11-03)
- Release rule → **A magnetic edges**: free X/Y; within 32 px of a work-area edge the widget snaps flush with today's margin (24 caption / 16 coin), otherwise it stays, always fully inside the work area. 32 DIP threshold confirmed on the mockup ("нормально").
- **Caption width resize in scope** (320–760 px, side handles, pref compactCaptionWidth) — same task.
- Position storage → **<userData>/window-state.json** `ghost` record (displayId + edge anchors/offsets in DIP), written by main; not a preference.
- **Added by the user:** the tools stay rectangular as long as they fit; only when the caption gets too low for two rows do they turn into one row of small squares (icon only, hold kept), and the window must not shrink past the point where the squares stop fitting — in scope of the same task.
- **Mouse only:** the arrow-key nudge shown in the mockup is NOT part of the implementation.
- Mockup: @docs/mockups/AUG-176/ghost-mode.html (option A is the default view).

## Implementation task
AUG-187-vc4nmp: Ghost Mode: free X/Y drag with magnetic edges, caption width resize and a saved position (incl. square tools at small sizes; mouse only).
